about: THE VENDOR PRIVATE ELEMENTS THE DIFFUSION RULES READ (diffusion-vendors.ts), declared for core's private-fields check (logic/readers/private-survey.ts): the Databases window compares them with what a database's series hold, so a private block no rule reads is shown as a gap rather than passed over in silence. Data, not code: no code fingerprint covers it, so declaring changes no working copy and no tract set. diffusion-vendors.test.ts checks this list against every lookup in diffusion-vendors.ts. 'part': only some of what the element holds is read.
